system.description:
A strong two-meter shoulder limb of hardened steel and ceramite, ending in gripping and crushing pincers. It gives +2 Strength for sustained force such as lifting or moving objects.

It can lift as a free action or be swung as a Club with the boosted Strength, but cannot handle fine tasks like typing or delicate objects. Only tech-priests can use mechadendrites, up to a number equal to their Constitution.
system.effectText: +2 Strength for sustained lifting; lifting as free action or used as a Club; no fine manipulation.
